structure_source: astro-templates/owl/ (role: primary) — fixed section order: hero -> promise-bar -> services-grid -> testimonials -> promise-band -> signature-system -> process-steps -> about -> seo-body -> faq -> blog-cards -> closing-cta -> footer. Native EstimateForm lead capture, no paste-in required.
brand_source: https://agcconcrete.com/ (role: secondary, client's real live site) — logo wordmark + CSS custom properties read directly from page source (no Firecrawl/Playwright available in this run; raw HTML fetched via curl and grepped for --color-* custom properties, font <link> tags, and the alt="Brand Logo" image). NOT used for layout/section rhythm per the anti-pattern lock — only color + font + logo + real photography.

palette._notes: accent (#ff143d) traced directly to the client's own CSS custom properties (--color-mcc49iue / --color-FF143D family, 7 occurrences) and matches the red in the 'AGC CONCRETE' wordmark logo. text/muted/surface traced to the site's dominant #000000 / #666666 / #f1f6f6-f3f8fb neutrals. accent_ink and accent_on_dark are derived (darkened / lightened) from the real accent to clear WCAG AA per astro-templates/owl/README.md's three-token contrast rule — verified with the template's own contrast-check script: text/bg 17.40, muted/bg 5.74, on-primary/primary 16.14, on-accent/accent 3.87 (passes the 3:1 large-bold-button threshold the template documents), accent-ink/bg 5.70, accent-ink/surface 5.30, accent-on-dark/primary 5.39 — all PASS.

typography._notes: Both traced directly to <link> tags to fonts.googleapis.com on agcconcrete.com (family=Outfit and family=Roboto) and to explicit font-family: Outfit declarations in the page's own inline styles. Both are real Google Fonts, no substitution needed.

avoid: purple / indigo / violet accents (client brand is red, not purple)
generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP (use the real 4.9 / 149 reviews instead)
randomized section order — always use the fixed owl order from the template
